sentences.text:
Shekhar Sarkar & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 14
March, 2024
14.03.2024
 Sl No.38
 Court No.8
 (gc)
 Crr 2813 of 2016
 Cran 1 of 2016 (Old No: Cran 4298 of 2016)

Shekhar Sarkar & Ors.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Debasish Roy, Ld. P.P.
 Mr. Rana Mukherjee, A.P.P.,
 ...for the State.

1.
None appears on behalf of the petitioners nor any accommodation is prayed for on behalf of the petitioners.
2. This criminal revisional application has been filed on 18th August, 2016 and it appears today in list after 16th December, 2016.
3. Accordingly, let an administrative notice be issued against the petitioners and the O.P. No.2 by Speed Post with A.D. within one week from date.

4. Let the matter be fixed on 5th April, 2024.
5.

Learned P.P. is directed to submit the status report of the G.R. Case No.1704 of 2015, arising out of New Town Police Station Case No.217 of 2015 dated 14.05.2015 Under Sections 498A/406/506/323/120B of the Indian Penal Code on the adjourned date.
